Globex Industries - Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

Maria Gomez, Chief Executive Officer: Good morning everyone. Globex Industries reported second
quarter 2026 revenue of $350 million, compared with $320 million a year ago. Growth came from our
industrial automation business.

Peter Chan, Chief Financial Officer: Gross margin was 38 percent. Consistent with our long-standing
policy, we are not providing any financial outlook or forward-looking guidance on this call.

Maria Gomez: Rising raw material costs remain a concern for our margins. Thank you for joining us.
